Root `pom.xml`: Maven parent (`pom`) aggregating modules: `ecommerce-common` (API envelope, exceptions, async config), `user-service`, `product-service`, `inventory-service`, `cart-service`, `order-service`, `payment-service`, `shipping-service`.

Layout: `<module>/src/main/java`, `<module>/src/main/resources` (`application.yml`), tests `<module>/src/test/java`. Root assets: `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`. Prereqs: Java 21, Maven 3.9+, Docker.

Commands:
`mvn clean package`
`mvn -pl user-service -am package`
`mvn -pl user-service spring-boot:run`
`java -jar user-service/target/user-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`
`docker compose up --build`
`mvn test` or `mvn -pl order-service test`

Use Java 4-space indentation, one public class/file; packages `com.example.ecommerce.<service>` with `controller`, `entity`, `repository`, `service`. Controllers e.g. `UserController` map under `/api/...`; entities e.g. `User`, `OrderItem`; repositories e.g. `UserRepository` (Spring Data JPA). Use `lowerCamelCase`, `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`. Prefer Lombok (`<REDACTED_USER>`, `<REDACTED_USER>`, etc.) where already used; reuse `ecommerce-common` types such as `ApiResponse`.

No tests checked in yet; add under `<module>/src/test/java`. Use JUnit 5 and `spring-boot-starter-test`; unit tests `*Test`, integration tests `*IT`.

No commit history; Conventional Commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`; include module scope, e.g. `feat(user-service): add address endpoints`. PRs: summary, affected modules, API examples (curl/Postman) for new endpoints, schema/config notes. Ensure module tests pass before merging.

Service config: each module’s `src/main/resources/application.yml`. Do not commit secrets; prefer environment variables for credentials. Local DB defaults in `docker-compose.yml`: `jdbc:mysql://mysql:3306/ecommerce`, user/password `ecommerce`.
